# AGT-JUS-02

**Is the autonomy level declared and proportionate to the impact and reversibility of what the agent does?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | JUS: Justified agency |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `elements.agent.autonomy_level`, `elements.agent.tools` |

## Rule

Every agent facet has autonomy_level; an agent at approver or observer has no tool that is irreversible and autonomous.

## Sources

- Feng, McDonald and Zhang, Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents (2025) (`knight-levels`)
- IMDA Singapore, Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI, v1.5 (2026) (`imda-agentic`)
